name: domain.migration_assistant
description: Python framework migration checker (Pydantic v1 to v2, Python 3.10+ union syntax, unittest to pytest)

entrypoints.name: check_pydantic_v2_readiness
entrypoints.description: Scan Python code for deprecated Pydantic v1 patterns (class Config, regex field parameter, validator decorator)

entrypoints.name: check_python_version_compat
entrypoints.description: Scan for deprecated legacy Python patterns (typing.Union instead of |, typing.Optional, distutils)
